name: Sturtevant Regional Distribution Center - Sturtevant WI

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via EPA RMP record (Sturtevant Regional Distribution Center, 2600 Enterprise Dr) + LoopNet/Colliers listings: 552,000 sq ft SCJ-owned aerosol-storage warehouse, LEED-Gold, 32-ft clear, 55 docks, 118 trailer staging positions. Roster coords (42.704751,-87.90962) sat near the NE office corner; building center relocated to ~42.70360,-87.91160 from satellite.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck yards on both the north and south long faces are fully enclosed by chain-link perimeter fencing — Street View (Jun 2019) along Enterprise Dr clearly shows continuous chain-link with trailers parked behind it on the south side. Controlled-access fenced compound with truck gates in the fence line where the perimeter loop road enters the yards.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at any gate in multiple Street View headings walked along Enterprise Dr (south side) and the NE/E access road. Entry is controlled by the fence/gates but unstaffed.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no guard shack -> remote check-in (kiosk/badge/app) is the implied control. Site sits inside a private SCJ-owned industrial parcel.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: continuous dock banks on BOTH the north and south long faces (visible in z18/z19 satellite, trailers backed in on both sides). Shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock clusters on opposite faces.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock bank along both ~220m faces; web research confirms 55 loading docks. Many trailers backed in on both faces -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large paved drop yards flank both long faces with numerous trailers parked without tractors; web research cites 118 trailer staging positions -> 50+.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved truck aprons on both faces with ample unused width to add an express/bypass lane at a gate.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main 552,000 sq ft RDC plus a separate smaller SCJ-occupied building immediately SW within the same fenced parcel.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two truck-yard gate openings observed in the perimeter fence (south yard and north/east loop).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park in Sturtevant WI (small village adjacent to I-94); open farmland borders the parcel to the west. Judged Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.multiStep: No second checkpoint observed; left false but flagged as not fully confirmable from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimate from perimeter box covering the building, both truck yards, and the office/parking; adjacent vacant land excluded.
